programme.desc: Hosted by Annie Chen, the 61st Television Drama Golden Bell Awards honours Taiwans outstanding television dramas, actors and creative teams. The ceremony recognises achievements in acting, directing, writing and production while celebrating the years finest stories.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers fast-paced coverage of the latest celebrity news, entertainment events and popular culture. Through studio segments, interviews, live reports and highlights, the programme keeps viewers informed about current stars, performances and industry developments.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: Cherry is a young girl addicted to the internet. After seeing a warning video about an e-ghost on YouTube, she begins to encounter many mysterious incidents, and the e-ghost also takes control of her family. Cherry must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world...

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: Stephen Chow returns in this hilarious and heartwarming tale of a father and son who discover an adorable alien in the trash.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the citys renowned Dumpling Queen.

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Locksmith Master Shan suffers from dementia and passes on his skills to Hao Ren, who surpasses him. Detective Liu often seeks Hao Rens help and they become good friends. When Hao Ren reunites with an old friend one day, he accidentally unfolds the truth behind Shans wifes disappearance, leading to a chain of mysterious events.

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect partners, Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003, when her mother is diagnosed with breast cancer. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father, and drifts away from her mother. When her younger sister is misdiagnosed with SARS, they finally open up to each other during quarantine.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: A group of bounty hunters, including San, Yo, Cat, Swan and Bobo, are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings that have plagued an international hotel group. Unfortunately, Swan, Cat and Bobo are kidnapped by the mastermind of the bombings. Can San and Yo save them? Will the bounty hunters accomplish their mission?

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wifes betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: In this Oscar nominee for Best International Feature Film, Nian faces relentless bullying from her peers as she prepares for her college entrance exam. Fate leads her to streetwise punk Bei, but before they can retreat into their own world, both are embroiled in a murder investigation that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire
programme.desc: This is a horror comedy about Sifu, Charlie Jiang, and his team of vampire hunters taking on the Vampire King who has been let loose on the streets of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: The revered elder of a triad gang faces succession uncertainty when his three trusted underlingsHua, Fei, and Guoare robbed while transporting gang money. Determined to redeem himself, Hua vows to track down the robbers. However, when Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Peg O My Heart
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Chois past?

programme.title: Imprisoned 2: There Is No Escape From Fate
programme.desc: Hong Kong businessman Yu and his secretary travel abroad for business meetings. When the secretary is killed in their hotel, Yu is arrested. Despite pleading not guilty, Yu is imprisoned in a cruel multinational prison where the warden enjoys torturing prisoners, and he must find a way to escape from this dark and deadly prison to survive.

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: S Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk witnesses a suspects murder while investigating an illegal soccer gambling case, but is unable to disclose information to Chief Inspector Lau due to his code of confidentiality, thereby hindering Laus investigation. While starting the case with mutual distrust, they end up reaching a rapport to uproot the crime syndicate.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, Red Hare may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile.

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader Yama Teng Wei-hao to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan Chen Hung and Pai Pan Hung Hsin-nan to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei Pai Piao...

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best. Its not so much the plot - a master swordsman protects a treasure chest on a dangerous journey - that makes this great, but what Sun does with it, inspiring the cast and crew to some of their finest work.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Fengs innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fte. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servants confusion, threatening the couples union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan heads son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Mings overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen Lin Chong gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the bosss daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack. The commandos enlist the help of Song San and Shiao Liu to kill the Japanese officers led by Shan Mao and destroy their attacking ships.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperors sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Rajini Murugan
programme.desc: Rajini Murugan, an unemployed youth, falls in love with Karthika, his cousin. But Karthikas father opposes the match.

programme.title: Shikari Shambu
programme.desc: A village seeks help from Peeli and his friends when a rogue tiger threatens their safety.

programme.title: Peechaankai
programme.desc: Tamil dark comedy film, Starring, RS Karthik, Anjali Rao, Vivek Prasanna and Others

programme.title: Bommai Nayagi
programme.desc: A heartfelt tale explores a father-daughter bond as their lives are shaped and strained by politics and societal pressures, revealing resilience, sacrifice, and hope amid changing times.

programme.title: Andhagaram
programme.desc: Movie

programme.title: Oru Naal Koothu
programme.desc: Three young women, who have different perspectives on marriage, struggle to lead a happy life as they deal with criticisms and parental pressure to get committed soon.

programme.title: Bruce Lee
programme.desc: A young neer-do-well is given a wake-up call when his girlfriend is kidnapped by an evil don.

programme.title: Kantara: A Legend Chapter-1
programme.desc: In pre-colonial Karnataka during the Kadamba dynasty, the tradition of Bhuta Kola becomes deeply rooted in local culture, while the origins of Kaadubettu Shiva begin to take shape.

programme.title: Haraa
programme.desc: Rams happy life shatters when his daughter supposedly dies. He investigates, uncovering medical scams and a prostitution ring. He rescues Nimisha, revealing she was to be sold.

programme.title: Kaapa
programme.desc: Anand fights to clear his wifes name from the KAAPA list, facing dangerous gangsters and a brutal conflict. Can he prove her innocence and survive the deadly consequences?

programme.title: V

programme.title: Game Changer
programme.desc: Ram Nandan, a government official, embarks on a relentless fight against corrupt politicians. Determined to bring about fair elections, he tries to revolutionise the way the government operates.

programme.title: Estate
programme.desc: A journalist and colleagues investigate Covelone Estate, rumored haunted. Their perilous exploration uncovers dangerous truths, threatening their lives as suspense and fear escalate.

programme.title: Beasts Of The Big Blue

programme.title: Wildlife Er

programme.title: Wildlife Er
programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koalas spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelles slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

programme.title: Wildlife Er
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Brees clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.title: Wildlife ER

programme.title: Wildlife ER

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon

Thatch realizes what the camera is doing, steals it and sets to take a photograph everyone in Scare School, hoping to trap them forever inside the little photographs and stick them in a big book of captured monsters! As Casper tries to type on the machine, it turns everything into a horrifyingly horrific story! The Headmasters absolutely adore Caspers story and ask him to write one every day! But strange events start taking place in school, students start disappearing at night and most of them are half-asleep the day after. programme.title: 风花雪月
programme.desc: 本片由两个单元故事组成首个故事讲述柳宣教策划了一个破玉通禅师色戒之奇计，着美艳妓女红莲向玉通大施色诱攻势第二个故事讲述少女冯玉华之母冯孙氏欠下九尾狐一笔钱无法偿还，被逼做妓女还债后冯孙氏因性病死去，遗下一笔债务以及殓葬费须玉华偿还；玉华无奈，只好踏上母亲所走过之路...

programme.title: 水晶人
programme.desc: 故事讲述，龙飞精心雕琢的水晶美人像忽然失踪后，多名黑道高手离奇被杀，江湖传言乃水晶人变成精灵杀人之所为龙飞经过连番追踪后，终发现水晶人乃日后训练之杀手水晶人揭发江湖厮杀之真正幕后人，实为伪装王爷的天帝...

programme.title: 杀手三分半钟
programme.desc: 职业杀手雷振华在尖东某夜总会成功杀死黑道名流四哥等人后，悄然来到马来西亚并住进唐人街对面一旧式旅馆唐人街的豪华酒店里正举行一个盛大婚礼，新郎石先生正是雷计画用三分半钟解决的目标，不料，未等雷下手，另一杀手已捷足先登，倒在地上却是另一要人，雷顿时成了替罪羊

programme.title: 女杀手
programme.desc: 女杀手被组织控制，强逼去杀商界名人石英，险中杀人灭口的陷阱她不想沦为杀人工具，决心进行报仇大计，故事曲折离奇...

programme.title: 花街时代
programme.desc: 少女美丽为谋生来到湾仔酒吧当吧女，自此沦落风尘其后，美丽在酒吧认识占美，深深爱上他，并确定自己已找到真爱当占美要离开的时候，伤心的美丽即陷入低潮，直到遇上黑帮头目王英才有了倚靠

programme.title: 烂头何
programme.desc: 青年侠盗何真看上歌妓翠红，翠却已被京城富豪王亲勤包起；王武功高强，深藏不露，实为康熙皇帝第十一子乔装；王见何为人率直重义气，且盗亦有道，故何虽多番放肆，王亦不以为忤；何本为官府通缉犯，王却暗中助其脱身；王此举无非望何改邪归正，但何不知收敛，王遂以计制之；后四太子为夺取皇权，把兄弟一一谋杀，特派梁将军谋杀王，何遂出手相助...

programme.title: 乾隆下江南
programme.desc: 乾隆为体察民情，撇下侍卫假扮商人微服出访江南，期间得知衙门有贪官欺压百姓，导致民不聊生这时乾隆遇上一名清廉的卖菜青年，二人合力教训贪官一顿最后，青年更被获封为皇帝的近身侍卫

programme.title: 大决斗
programme.desc: 得知弟弟杀死黑社会头目后，唐人杰毅然承担罪责，成为杀手追杀的目标在江南浪子的协助下，他终于成功复仇，却惊觉江南浪子正是杀害父亲的真凶

programme.title: 寒烟翠
programme.desc: 陈咏薇的父母准备离异，于是把她送到章家暂住章家长子凌霄次子凌风三女凌云和年轻画家余亚南都对咏薇很好，使她在章家农场度过了难忘的暑假

programme.title: 水浒传
programme.desc: 此片是张彻导演的史诗式武侠钜作宋朝官府被贪官污吏和土豪劣绅控制，于是宋江带领一百零八位英雄义士齐集梁山这羣实力非凡的英雄好汉，形成了一股强大的武装势力，一场梁山好汉与官府的大战就此展开

programme.title: 弟子也疯狂
programme.desc: 方世玉洪熙官与胡惠干三位俗家弟子初入少林，拜于南院戒嗔大师门下习武然而，三人常与出家弟子悟清较劲切磋，寺中从此喧嚷不绝，连方丈见此情景亦不免啼笑皆非

programme.title: 小煞星
programme.desc: 强宜本是夜总会歌星，后来为寻初恋女友水仙的下落，被人带到匪帮的木屋原来，强宜少年时误入歧途，有打劫杀人的犯罪纪录，绰号小煞星一哥要胁他共同打劫珠宝行，否则公开他的秘密强宜假意应承，从长计议想不到当日行动踏入珠宝行，发现售货员竟然是初恋女友水仙！

programme.title: 女子公寓
programme.desc: 故事背景为一幢女子公寓，房东陈太太痛恨男人，严禁男性进入，不幸，女房客却多靠男性而活；歌女尤淑文由台北飞到香港，找寻失踪的妹妹；尤经作曲家王德生介绍到居所楼上之女子公寓居住...

programme.title: 请帖
programme.desc: 青年侠士辛酸得悉王爷拟委托四大杀手押送神秘箱子往西安，且将付出十万两银子作酬金，辛遂杀四人及持其头颅往见王爷，求接办保镖事，盖辛欲得该笔巨额酬金作赈灾之用，王爷允之辛途遇妙手怪丐杨风无形剑客古非天及美艳女侠水仙花等高手截劫原来当中牵涉通敌叛国的阴谋...

programme.title: 销魂玉
programme.desc: 王致和无意得到通灵玩意，许下三个愿望，虽然愿望灵验之极，结果落得家散人亡；风尘女孟薇被情人林坤全害死，变成水鬼复仇；艳丽女子萧云玉香消玉殒后，仍不断在人间走动，盗坟贼欲挖开萧云玉坟墓盗取陪葬珠宝，终被萧云玉追杀致死...

programme.title: 死囚
programme.desc: 流浪汉冯大刚被误指为劫匪，遭逮捕后关押于死囚牢真正的劫匪为了灭口，贿赂狱中扒手杨灵对冯大刚下毒手杨灵明白冯大刚是冤枉的，于是暗中设法帮助他逃狱谁料逃狱计划意外失败，最终两人反而成为真正的死囚

programme.title: 花田错
programme.desc: 故事讲述千金小姊刘月英与丫鬟春兰同游花田盛会，邂逅桥边画画的落拓书生卞济春兰眼见小姊芳心暗许，于是穿针引线，欲促成良缘，却因老家仆错认小霸王周通为卞济，使小姊与卞济情路波折重重在经过一连串误会与错配后，结局乃皆大欢喜

programme.title: 飞刀手
programme.desc: 绰号飞刀追魂的焦雷与乾坤剑名手于远结怨，焦要追杀于全家幸得飞刀手杨青救了于的女儿于英；但杨青生性风流，向于英开出对付焦雷的条件是共渡一夜于英憎恶他，又不得不和他一起助父亲与焦雷决斗相处日久，于英才明白杨非登徒浪子，实对她深爱非常

programme.title: 七仙女
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永卖身传员外家，为奴以埋父骨；其孝心感动了七仙女，便幻成村姑，在六位仙姊下凡暗助下，为董缩减偿还工作日，回复自由后，二人回董故家，但愉快的凡间生活能持续多久呢？

programme.title: 蒙面大侠
programme.desc: 汉高祖死后,吕后专权,密诏太尉设法杀死代王刘恒蒙面大侠发现其诡计后，马上告知刘恒刘于是急遣护卫保护公主往长安求援太尉率大队军马沿途追杀公主,幸得蒙面大侠保护,处处化险为夷最后，蒙面大侠更助刘恒成功继承汉室大统

programme.title: 何日君再来
programme.desc: 富家子卓明不顾父亲反对，与歌女雪玲结婚，并因此与家庭断绝关系婚后，雪玲怀孕，卓明因过度劳累导致视力衰退为维持家计，雪玲重操旧业登台演唱，而卓明不愿拖累妻子，选择悄然离开在友人鼓励下，雪玲再次公开献唱，卓明深受感动，最终与妻儿重逢

programme.title: 满天神佛
programme.desc: 一次驱鬼时，青年术士鲁兴与友人因功力太差被女鬼戏弄险告丧命，幸得连大师施法帮助，才将女鬼驱逐于是二人马上拜他为师友人意外地被日本忍者所杀，鲁兴决定要学习绝世茅术，与大师一起对付残暴的忍者，因而引发终极乱斗！

programme.title: 中华英雄
programme.desc: 1913年，华英雄惨遭灭门，愤然流亡美国妻子洁瑜怀孕寻夫，二人异乡重逢孰料龙凤胎出生当夜，中华楼遭敌纵火，洁瑜惨死女婴被掳十六年后，子华剑雄踏上寻父之路，华英雄则于自由女神像顶，与宿敌无敌展开生死决战

programme.title: 再见七日情
programme.desc: 护卫员阿逊被派往保护富商的儿子，期间巧遇住在隔壁的祖儿，更渐渐爱上她，却发现原来祖儿是富商的情妇当他俩的恋情被富商发现后，事情一发不可收拾！

programme.title: 黑白潜行2
programme.desc: 在莱咖国政权交替之际，黑帮头目宋邦企图藉此洗白身份，欲坐上市长宝座为了筹措庞大资金，他与官员勾结行贿，却仍面临严重的资金缺口于是，宋邦的得力助手郑咤和打手苏万杀人越货横行作恶，逐步帮助他巩固权力正当宋邦自以为能坐享其成时，三人的关系却突然逆转

programme.title: 追女三十六房
programme.desc: 故事描述一间猛男训练中心专门教授男人在情场上的杀着可惜校长与其女友缠绵时不幸暴毙，学校三位教授想出招数争夺学校拥有权，闹出连场笑话...

programme.title: 除恶: 飞车党
programme.desc: 佛山刑警林岩成立精英专案小组，专门重拳打击嚣张跋扈的街头飞车大盗及其幕后庞大的犯罪集团然而，当他身怀六甲的妻子惨遭猖狂飞车贼蓄意撞击，生死未卜之时，极度悲愤的他意外揭开了一场隐匿在黑恶势力深处的凶险复仇阴谋

programme.title: 伤城
programme.desc: 屡破奇案的凶杀组总督察刘正熙的富豪岳父惨遭谋杀，刘正熙太太因对警方的调查进展产生怀疑，请来丈夫昔日的生死之交私家侦探丘建邦调查真相随着调查不断深入，案情峰回路转，丘建邦最终发现案件竟与刘正熙有着千丝万缕的关系

programme.title: 赌城大亨II 之至尊无敌
programme.desc: 本片是赌城大亨之新哥传奇的续集，讲述贺新用了20年时间，成功建立其赌业王国，但同伴却不甘屈居其下，于是设局争夺赌业控制权另一方面，青年傅震为贺新旧情人的儿子，以为父亲被新所杀，便处心积虑安排报仇大计胆识过人的贺新面对各样的威胁，绝不坐以待弊

programme.title: 审死官
programme.desc: 周星驰饰演著名状师宋世杰，经常不择手段为富人打赢官司，让他们逍遥法外，因此妻子迫使他退隐乡间然而，当宋夫人结识一位丈夫之死被贪官掩盖的妇人时，宋世杰决定挺身而出，再次在公堂上伸张正义，为她讨回公道

programme.title: 风云雄霸天下
programme.desc: 十年前，笃信命理的天下会霸主雄霸请来泥菩萨推算命运泥菩萨预言，若想称霸武林，必须收两位名字分别带有风与云的少年为徒，他们将助他成就霸业，也将左右他一生的命运霸业虽成，预言却骤然逆转，一场由批言引发的武林浩劫，彻底改变了整个武林的命运

programme.title: 摩登仙履奇缘
programme.desc: 陈七是职业惯匪，偷呃拐骗无所不为，但从不使用暴力；张曼珠是电视台新晋演员，收入微薄，生活拮据一次偶然中，陈得到了一枚巨钻，欲找买家脱手，却遇杀手追杀，情急下将巨钻藏于某鞋店的一只高跟鞋内，后来，此鞋刚好被张买去参加舞会

programme.title: 爱的世界
programme.desc: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生

programme.title: 叶问 2
programme.desc: 日本侵华后，咏春大师叶问与家人因生活艰难离开佛山，远赴香港开馆收徒，希望可以开展新生活但事情并未如所想般容易，他欲在香港开武馆，就必须接受各大门派的挑战一场又一场的功夫较量正式展开！

programme.title: 无敌幸运星
programme.desc: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱幸运星打算骗假飞飞结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计

programme.title: 飞龙再生
programme.desc: 香港特警阿狄在跨国追捕人蛇集团时，为救圣童不幸溺毙，却意外在再生龙章圣光中重获新生，并获得惊人的自愈能力岂料宿敌同样夺取神力，设局步步追杀退无可退的阿狄孤身深入虎穴，在幽暗古堡展开一场拳拳到肉生死一线的终极激战

programme.title: 种鬼
programme.desc: 故事描述，计程车司机周通高飞饰之妻艾莲玄智慧饰红杏出墙，搭上赌场常客方明徐少强饰一日，艾与方争执后独自离去，却被流氓挟往荒屋施暴，艾极力反抗，终堕楼惨死周受一股神秘力量引导，发现艾尸首，蒙眬间，闻鬼语遣其往找巫师设法报仇自始怪事接连发生，所有与艾之死有关的人均遭鬼怪缠扰...

programme.title: 赤脚小子
programme.desc: 穷乡青年关丰曜，终日赤着双脚，以背人过河为活关父临终前，嘱其出城投靠段青云；段骤见故人之子，留下关在布店当小工关与私塾女教师华小莲交心，却遭莲父白眼；关为求出人头地，竟往投靠土霸喀和布，结果连累莲父与段相继被喀暗算身亡关得知真相，惜为时已晚，追悔莫及，决与喀拼过死活...

programme.title: 鹿鼎记
programme.desc: 韦小宝被反清复明的天地会被派到皇宫当卧底，受命查探四十二章经下落韦小宝很快成为康熙皇帝的心腹，但他既要执行天地会的任务，最后陷入两难的状态

programme.title: 烈探
programme.desc: 警探张荼为救落入人贩之手的儿子，不惜孤身深入敌穴，跨国追击，但却被牵扯进大型儿童拐卖案在寻找儿子的过程中，他和身份神秘的女子携手捣毁了一个大型国际犯罪集团，上演了一场惊心动魄的绝地生死营救

programme.title: 七小福
programme.desc: 本片是改编自京剧大师于占元师傅的真实故事六十年代戏剧文化日渐衰落，但于师傅仍坚持要保留他的戏剧学院三个少年决意入读于师傅的戏剧研究学院，向他拜师学艺，经过艰辛的训练过程后，于师傅终于成功造就香港影坛这三大巨星

programme.title: 珠光宝气
programme.desc: 一名商人的私生女，无意中擦出神仙阿宝，并得到三个愿望可惜阿宝法术不精，而发生了很多啼笑皆非的事

programme.title: 僵尸先生
programme.desc: 茅山师父九叔受委托为富翁起棺迁葬，祈求新墓地能催财惟富翁之尸体出现尸变后，变成僵尸，并在村内四处为害此时，九叔的两名徒弟亦分别被僵尸所伤和受女鬼迷惑九叔如何同时面对徒弟们生死存亡，以及僵尸为害的问题呢？

programme.title: 缘份
programme.desc: 一个刚毕业的年青人在地铁站内邂逅一个美丽动人的女子，并对她一见钟情在另一方面，他正被一个富家女展开追求而此时他倾心的那女子，也正周旋于一个已婚男子之中当那年青人向她表白时，那女子要求与他在地铁站内玩捉迷藏来决定大家的缘份！

programme.title: 火云邪神之修罗面具
programme.desc: 十八年前，邪恶的黑羽会潜入了老邪神西城勇的地盘，盗走了修罗面具，而利用修罗面具放出当时只是个婴儿的魔神老邪神为了魔神日后不作恶收养了婴儿，教他好好做人，成为小邪神小邪神最后控制了面具的力量成为老邪神的接班人，继续守护城市

programme.title: 逃学威龙
programme.desc: 飞虎队精英周星星奉命潜入校园，调查一宗警枪失窃案在拍档达叔的协助下，他不仅成功寻回失枪，更意外揭发一宗大型地下军火交易走私集团为报复，悍然持械闯入学校，挟持多名学生作为人质周星星必须不惜一切代价，拯救所有人质

programme.title: 武状元苏乞儿
programme.desc: 苏乞儿原为贵族，但因上京考武状元时作弊，被眨为乞儿苏乞儿在机缘巧合下救了丐帮长老，并接任为新帮主一天，皇上狩猎之时，差点被暗杀，幸苏乞儿及时救驾皇帝欲恢复其官职时，苏乞儿却拒绝其后，皇上御赐一个乞儿钵予苏乞儿，从此他过着愉快的行乞生活

programme.title: 让子弹飞
programme.desc: 悍匪张牧之劫持火车，冒充新任县长强横进驻鹅城本想靠升官发财大捞一笔，却撞上了只手遮天的当地地头蛇恶霸黄四郎在满嘴谎言的骗子师爷马邦德的利益周旋下，黑白两道展开一场智力与火力的巅峰对决在这场荒诞的杀戮游戏中，且看子弹如何飞往最终的真相

programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.title: 解决师 第5集
programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全张颕康饰，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace冯盈盈饰深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如陈敏之饰的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 第11集
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第14集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第29集
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复

programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.title: 解决师 第7集
programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全张颕康饰，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace冯盈盈饰深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如陈敏之饰的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 第12集
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第15集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 第20集
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.title: 解决师 第7集
programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全张颕康饰，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace冯盈盈饰深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如陈敏之饰的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第6集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变

programme.title: 爱情食物链 第15集
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 第25集
programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量

programme.title: 大酱园 第23集
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 토리 GO! GO!
programme.desc: 엉뚱하고 호기심 많은 주인공 토리. 해맑게 자라나는 토리의 솔직 담백 성장기. 엄마와 딸 셋! 모녀이기 이전에 여자! 가족이지만 그 속에서 겪는 여자로서의 미묘한 갈등들. 그리고 중간에 끼어 언니와 동생에 채일 수밖에 없는 둘째의 설움. 그러나 우리의 토리는 그런 것에 아랑곳하지 않고 자신의 생각과 신념으로만 행동하는 속칭 눈치 없는 이 시대의 아이이며, 우리 모두의 아이이다.
